understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid and complete every level by matching the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation to each goal cell, then stepping onto the matched goal.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions navigate the grid, while walls block movement. Shape, color, and rotation modifier tiles change the corresponding piece attributes; rotation modifiers rotate the piece 90° clockwise. A goal is completed only when all three attributes match. Each move consumes stamina, including blocked moves. When stamina reaches zero, a life is lost and stamina resets; losing all lives ends the game.
